scope: Eight-row visibility read tiles and non-raster state retention on the existing explicitly opted-in exclusive 2010 buffered DC. Drawing order, recorded traces, custom callbacks/samplers/sinks and all unopted DCs retain their previous behavior.
checks: Signed-I32 coordinate normalization and bounds checks precede cache lookup. Eight-row tiles are clipped to the canvas bottom; getImageData ignores canvas clipping state.
Every supported raster primitive invalidates before dispatch, including bitmap/native text and setPixel. Message-beep callbacks and unknown events also conservatively invalidate.
Movement, selection, text/background state, clipping save/restore and read events do not mutate canvas pixels and may reuse cached data in the exclusive-sink lifetime.
The tile cache stays bounded to64 entries and is disabled for custom samplers/sinks or recorded events. The 2002 browser does not opt into caching.
No path, fill, stroke, antialiasing or physics batching was introduced; Canvas primitive calls stay in their previous order.
performanceScope: Reduced eligible readback count is covered by Node tests. Browser latency measurements are owned by the parent; no FPS inference is made here.
